title: Paid Ads Specialist
description:
About the job

Company Description

Hire Unity partners with small to medium-sized businesses throughout the United States by providing recruitment services that connect employers with highly qualified global talent.







Role Description

As our Paid Ads Specialist, you will own paid acquisition at Hire Unity. You will plan, launch, and scale campaigns across Meta Ads and Google Ads that drive qualified client leads into our sales pipeline. Success in this role looks like one thing: a predictable, profitable flow of qualified leads, measured in ROAS and CPA.




Responsibilities:

 • Plan, launch, and manage paid campaigns across Meta Ads and Google Ads for lead generation and brand awareness

 • Write ad scripts, hooks, and direct-response copy across static, video, and short-form formats

 • Develop creative concepts and angles, run A/B tests, and turn winning ideas into new variations

 • Write creative briefs and collaborate with designers, editors, and UGC creators on assets

 • Align ad copy and landing page messaging to each campaign and audience

 • Own campaign budgets and pacing, and report on spend, ROAS, CPA, CTR, and other key metrics

 • Build and manage retargeting and audience-building funnels

 • Set up and maintain conversion tracking, including Meta Pixel, UTM parameters, and Google Tag Manager

 • Track performance in our CRM and coordinate with the sales team so ad-generated leads flow cleanly into the pipeline

 • Deliver weekly and monthly performance reports with clear insights and recommendations




Qualifications

 • Hands-on experience running campaigns in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads (required)

 • Strong copywriting and ad-scripting skills, including short-form video and direct-response copy

 • Familiarity with Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager

 • Strong analytical skills, creativity, and attention to detail

 • Consistent, clear written English communication

 • Reliable and self-directed in a remote environment

description:
About the job

Job Description

About Us

The Kraft Heinz Company is one of the largest food and beverage companies in the world, with eight $1 billion+ brands and global sales of approximately $25 billion. We’re a globally trusted producer of high-quality, great-tasting, and nutritious foods for over 150 years. Our brands are truly global, with products produced and marketed in over 40 countries. These beloved products include condiments and sauces, cheese and dairy, meals, meats, refreshment beverages, coffee, infant and nutrition products, and numerous other grocery products in a portfolio of more than 200 legacy and emerging brands.

No matter the brand, we’re united under one vision: To sustainably grow by delighting more consumers globally. Bringing this vision to life is our team of 39,000+ food lovers, creative thinkers, and high performers worldwide. Together, we help provide meals to those in need through our global partnership with Rise Against Hunger. We also stand committed to responsible, sustainable practices that extend to every facet of our business, our consumers, and our communities. Every day, we’re transforming the food industry with bold thinking and unprecedented results. If you share our passion – and are ready to create the future, build a legacy, and lead as a global citizen – there’s only one thing to do: join our table and let’s make life delicious!

Our Culture of Ownership, Meritocracy & Collaboration

We're not afraid to think differently. Embrace new ideas. Dream big. We empower our people at every level – from entry-level intern to senior leader – to own their work. We share a responsibility to think like Owners – to be mindful of the collective and sustained success of Kraft Heinz – which we apply to every situation, every day. As part of Kraft Heinz, you're supported to grow and achieve. You’re expected to bring your authentic self to work every day, to lead with humility, and drive outstanding performance at every level – and you’ll be rewarded. You’re given opportunities to leave a mark and build a legacy. But you won’t do it alone. You’re supported by passionate teammates along the way, and our collective, collaborative spirit fuels our incredible progress.

Job Description

WHO WE ARE

We're one of the world's largest food and beverage companies and a trusted producer of high-quality, great-tasting, and nutritious foods, earning us a spot on 97% of American household tables. As the guardians of our beloved brands and the creators of innovative products, we're dedicated To Sustainably Grow by Delighting More Consumers Globally.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

As a Sr. Analyst within the Growth and R&D Tech Capabilities team, you will drive critical projects across the Consumer Insights & Data and broader marketing technology portfolio. You will partner closely with business stakeholders and technical teams to turn consumer insights, data, analytics, and marketing activation objectives into digital solutions. In this role, you will:


Collaborate with business stakeholders to capture business requirements and translate them into technical execution actions
Lead technology project management activities, including program submission and approval, budget and value tracking, implementation, and project closure
Partner with cross-functional teams, such as Marketing, Sales, eCommerce, Omni, and Global Business Services to understand business needs and pain-points– and provide technical solutions
Coordinate across technical delivery team – including data engineering, data architecture, data science, AI/ML Ops, and software engineering -- to drive delivery of committed business requirements
Manage an assigned portfolio of SaaS applications, ensuring technical health, security, and lifecycle requirements are implemented and maintained


WHO YOU ARE

You bring a blend of technical depth, project discipline, and strong cross-functional collaboration. You are comfortable working across business and technical teams, translating requirements into action, and staying organized and proactive in a rapidly evolving environment.

Qualifications


2-3 years of experience in IT and/or data and analytics, ideally within a large Fortune 500 organization
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or a related discipline
Strong understanding of data and analytics processes, data product development methodologies, and platforms; such as, Snowflake, PowerBI, Tableau
Experience with consumer insights and voice-of-customer tech and tools, ie. Talkwalker, Nichefire, Yogi, Salesforce, and Profitero
Hands-on experience with workflow management tools; ie. Monday.com, Airtable, JIRA
Technical project management and vendor management experience is a must
Interest in and proven learning agility with emerging Agentic AI capabilities
Strong communication and collaboration skills across business and technical stakeholders
Ability to listen, understand and synthesize business needs and translate requirements into technical architecture, engineering, and reporting activities
Solid analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach to decision-making
Ownership mindset and ability to work as a self-starter
Resilience and adaptability in a rapidly evolving business and technology landscape
Ability to prioritize work, manage budgets, and support on-time delivery
Detail-oriented written and verbal communication skills to present project updates and risks to leadership


Ready to help future-proof our legacy? Join our table, and Let's Make Life Delicious!

title: Analista de Customer Success - Mexico
description:
About the job

🚀 Somos Inceptia

Cambiamos la manera en que las empresas interactúan con sus clientes usando Inteligencia Artificial conversacional — bots de voz y chat que gestionan cobranzas, ventas y atención al cliente a escala.




🔎 ¿Qué buscamos?

Analista de Customer Success — Perfil Técnico

📍 Noroeste de México — Hermosillo, Culiacán o Tijuana · Home office, con residencia en la región




🧙 Acerca del rol

Serás el puente entre nuestros clientes y la plataforma de Inceptia. Tu día a día combina soporte técnico-funcional, optimización de bots y acompañamiento en integraciones, con foco en que cada cliente saque el máximo valor de sus campañas.




No es un rol de soporte reactivo tipo call center: buscamos a alguien que identifique proactivamente oportunidades de mejora, proponga cambios en los flujos conversacionales y se involucre en la implementación junto al equipo de desarrollo.




🙌 Por qué unirte a Inceptia?

• Somos una empresa de Tecnología de IA. Trabajás con modelos de IA conversacional de punta.

• Contrato formal, en nómina y con prestaciones de ley (IMSS, aguinaldo, vacaciones).

• Esquema 100% home office: no necesitás mudarte ni viajar, solo vivir en la región.

• Aprendizaje constante en un producto de IA que está creciendo mes a mes en México y Centroamérica.




📌 Responsabilidades

• Gestionar la configuración y el lanzamiento de campañas de bots de voz y chat para clientes.

• Brindar soporte técnico y funcional ante consultas e incidentes sobre la plataforma.

• Diseñar, modificar y optimizar prompts conversacionales para mejorar el rendimiento de los bots.

• Acompañar a clientes en la integración vía API: explicar el funcionamiento del endpoint, validar payloads, identificar errores de carga y coordinar con desarrollo cuando corresponda.

• Realizar auditorías periódicas de bots para detectar problemas y oportunidades de mejora en flujos, tasas de contacto y resolución.

• Coordinar con el equipo de desarrollo la implementación de cambios en configuraciones de bots y telefonía.

• Documentar configuraciones, procesos y guías de integración para clientes y uso interno.

• Capacitar a usuarios clave de los clientes en el uso de la plataforma.

• Analizar datos de gestión (contactabilidad, estados, resultados) para generar insights y reportes ejecutivos.




✅ Lo indispensable

• Formación técnica: estudiante avanzado (desde 3er año) o egresado de Sistemas, Ingeniería, Informática o afín.

• Perfil analítico y resolutivo: cómodo leyendo documentación técnica, probando cosas y resolviendo problemas sin esperar todo resuelto.

• Conocimiento de APIs REST: lectura de documentación, armado de requests (curl / Postman), interpretación de errores HTTP y JSON.

• Capacidad de leer y escribir scripts básicos (Python, JS u otro lenguaje) — no buscamos un desarrollador full-time, pero sí a alguien que no le tenga miedo al código.

• Buena comunicación, tanto con interlocutores técnicos como de negocio.

• Residencia en Hermosillo, Culiacán o Tijuana (o alrededores).




⭐ Suma, aunque no es excluyente

• Experiencia previa en Customer Success técnico, soporte avanzado o implementación de software (2-3 años es un buen benchmark, pero priorizamos potencial y actitud sobre años exactos).

• Interés o experiencia en prompt engineering: redactar instrucciones para LLMs, ajustar el comportamiento conversacional, probar y evaluar resultados.

• Manejo de alguna herramienta de datos (Power BI, BigQuery, Tableau, tablas dinámicas avanzadas u otra similar).

• Experiencia previa en plataformas de bots, IVR, contact center o cobranzas.

• Conocimiento de telefonía VoIP / SIP.

• Entendimiento de Inglés

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity and support where every team member’s voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities


Troubleshoot and solve external user issues
Communicate resolutions to end users in English
Analyze our processes and instigate changes to help scale our operations and improve user experience 
Work closely with other Stripe teams to improve our product offerings and messaging around new products and features 
Gain unique insights into how thousands of businesses on Stripe scale and operate 
Have an opportunity to learn how Stripe operates from ground up and make a real impact on the future organization 
Be a part of building a brand new team and operational culture for Stripe 
Partner with global operations specialists or business process owners to run a critical workflow



Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


You have a user first mindset and are energized by the challenge of solving difficult problems
You have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
You have business proficiency in written and spoken English 
You excel in analytical thinking and problem solving
You might have prior experience in customer service or internal/external user facing operations
You enjoy learning about technical products and processes, you are an organized, self-starter with passion for finding solutions to user’s challenges
You have a process-oriented mindset and ability to get things done
You enjoy working in an in-office environment with strong cross team collaboration and support
You are able to prioritize and enjoy working in a quick-moving environment
You are humble and have a proven track record for working well across teams and with external partners
You're willing to periodically work a weekend day for which you will receive a weekday off; the SDC operates during daytime hours with shifts from the morning through early evening



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience or knowledge in user support 
Prior experience working on projects or process improvement initiatives 
Familiarity with SQL and ability to use template or premade SQL queries as part of investigations



Applicants are personally responsible for obtaining and maintaining the right to work in Mexico.

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

description:
About the job

About the Team

The Sales Compliance team is responsible for designing and ensuring effective Sales Compliance and Controls across DoorDash's sales organization. The Sales Compliance team is part of the larger Sales Strategy & Operations team which accelerates productivity and develops go-to-market strategies and processes to support our sales organization. This group builds the engine and foundation for DoorDash to achieve the best selection for our platform and grow revenues across all business lines.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Associate, Sales Compliance to operate and enhance our key revenue related SOX controls, which ensures all commission rate changes and merchant pricing terms are contractually supported, accurately configured in system, and correctly applied to charges.

This role is responsible for overseeing monthly contract-to-system-to-charge reconciliations, investigating exceptions, partnering cross-functionally to remediate issues, and demonstrating operating effectiveness to Internal and External Audit. You will play a critical role in revenue assurance, control execution, and audit support across multiple geographies and business lines.

You will report to the Senior Manager, Sales Compliance within Sales Strategy & Operations. This role is hybrid, based in Mexico City, MX.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…


Perform a key SOX revenue control on a monthly cadence
Review contract → system → delivery-level charge reconciliations
Review commission rate changes and new merchant onboardings for compliance
Investigate mismatches, quantify exposure, and drive remediation
Maintain audit-ready documentation supporting control execution
Partner with Engineering to build and refine reconciliation data views
Identify control gaps and recommend process improvements
Present control results and risk findings to Finance and Internal Audit


We're excited about you because…


You have 3+ years of experience in external audit (Big 4 preferred), internal audit, or SOX compliance
You have experience testing or operating revenue-related controls
You understand revenue recognition and order-to-cash processes
You are highly proficient in Excel and comfortable working with large datasets
You have working knowledge of SQL or experience partnering with data teams
You have strong attention to detail and enjoy investigating data discrepancies
You are comfortable owning a recurring control and interacting directly with auditors
You are organized, process-driven, and thrive in a controlled environment


About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

About the job

Who You’ll Work With

 

The Research & Insights practice at Slalom is a growing team of roughly 20 researchers spanning qualitative, quantitative, UX, and market research disciplines. We work directly with clients to uncover what their customers want, what their markets are doing, and what their data is saying, so that when organizations move, they move on something real.

We bring human craft and modern tools to every engagement. The result is research that does not stop at the finding, it follows through to the decision, the strategy, and the work that gets done.




What You’ll Do

 

The Research Strategist brings quantitative rigor and qualitative depth to client engagements, designing research that uncovers what customers actually think, do, and need, and translating those findings into strategies organizations can act on.

This role sits at the center of client delivery, owning the research design, leading the analysis, and shaping the so-what. Beyond the research, this person connects insight to decision, decision to strategy, and strategy to action- helping clients move forward with evidence behind them and confidence in front of them. A curiosity about AI in research and synthetic methods is part of how we expect to shape the future. 

 

1) Research Design & Methodology

Select and justify research methods across quantitative and qualitative approaches, with a clear rationale for why one method serves the objective better than another
Design survey instruments with rigorous attention to question architecture, scale selection, skip logic, and sample design to ensure findings are statistically credible & analytically useful
Define research questions, hypotheses, and success criteria at the outset of an engagement to keep the work anchored to business outcomes rather than research process

 

2) Research Execution, Synthesis and Analysis

Design, field, and analyze surveys end-to-end, including segmentation, cross-tabs, and significance testing, translating statistical output into findings a business leader can act on

Synthesize findings across methods into a single, cohesive insight narrative that integrates behavioral, attitudinal, and market data into a complete picture of the customer
Analyze qualitative data with rigor, identifying patterns and tensions in the data rather than simply surfacing themes that confirm the hypothesis
Know when the data is telling you something unexpected and have the analytical confidence to follow it, even when it complicates the story

 

3) Research-to-Action Translation

Translate research findings into strategic recommendations that are specific, prioritized, and tied to a business outcome rather than a restatement of what the data said
Create customer-facing outputs including journey maps, experience diagnostics, and personas grounded in research evidence, then shape the strategic narratives that connect research to the decisions and investments that follow
Frame implications for different audiences, sharpening the so-what for an executive and the so-now-what for a product or delivery team

Manage client expectations around research scope, timeline, and findings, communicating proactively when something in the data or the process requires a change in direction

Core Skills

Strong quantitative experience: survey design, segmentation, regression, and significance testing

Ability to synthesize behavioral, attitudinal, and market data into a clear, structured point of view

description:
About the job

Description

Join a small, high-impact legal team that serves as the single legal function for Amazon Mexico's entire Operations business — logistics, transportation, supply chain, fulfillment, and last-mile delivery. You'll own complex legal matters end-to-end, advise senior leaders directly, and work on problems where regulations are unclear and the business needs answers fast.


 You will be the go-to lawyer for a large, fast-moving operations org. This is not a support role — you own the work, make the calls, and drive outcomes.
 The work spans commercial contracts, regulatory compliance, labor matters, government engagement, third-party logistics, and new program launches across Mexico.
 You'll need to be comfortable making decisions with limited information, calibrating risk in real time, and sometimes showing up at an operations site to handle a regulator visit in person.
 This role requires someone who understands how operations actually work on the ground, not just the legal theory, but the physical network, the programs, and the people.
 We are enablers, not gatekeepers. We help the business move fast and manage risk properly. If you default to "no" or need all the facts before taking a position, this is not the right fit.


Key job responsibilities


 Own complex legal matters end-to-end across Amazon Mexico's operations — logistics, transportation, supply chain, fulfillment, and last-mile delivery.
 Draft, negotiate, and manage commercial agreements with third-party logistics providers, carriers, and operational partners.
 Advise senior leaders on Mexican regulatory compliance (transportation, labor, customs, environmental) and help the business move fast.
 Make risk-calibrated decisions under ambiguity with limited information. Escalate fast when needed.
 Handle government and regulator interactions, including unannounced site visits — travel to operations sites on short notice when required.
 Build scalable tools (playbooks, SOPs, self-service guides) so business teams can handle routine matters independently.
 Coordinate with other legal functions (Labor & Employment, Public Policy, Trade, Real Estate) to deliver consolidated advice.
 Manage outside counsel on specific matters.
 Develop deep knowledge of how the physical operations network works to maintain business continuity and give advice grounded in reality.


A day in the life

You start the morning closing a contract with an unusual structure — you figure out where the real risk is, draft protections, and get it back to the business fast. After lunch, a regulator shows up unannounced at a warehouse. You join a call with the site leaders and guide the team through it. Later, a business team asks if a new program is legal. The regulation is vague, there's no precedent. You do a quick analysis, set guardrails, and give them the green light. No two days look the same.

About The Team

MX Operations Legal is the legal function supporting Amazon Mexico's full operations business — from how products enter the country to how they reach the customer's door. We work directly with senior operations leaders across transportation, fulfillment, supply chain, and last-mile delivery. The team is small and high-impact: you won't be reviewing someone else's work. You'll own your matters, make your own calls, and see your advice turn into real outcomes. We value practical judgment, speed, autonomy, and people who can stay calm when things are messy.

Basic Qualifications


 5+ years of Inhouse legal or law firm experience
 Experience in Regulatory Law
 Experience in Commercial Transportation Law
 Speak, write, and read fluently in Spanish and English at C1 level or above
 Mexican Law degree (Licenciatura en Derecho, J.D., or foreign equivalent that has been homologated in Mexico)


Preferred Qualifications


 LL.M. (Taxation), or Master's degree
 Experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, import/export operations, or data entry/data administration
 Experience building scalable programs and repeatable scalable processes, levering various tools and methods to create scale and efficiency

Verificar la identidad del cliente y validar datos base de contacto de acuerdo con los procedimientos y controles operativos autorizados, antes de comunicar cualquier información de la oferta.

Confirmar la elegibilidad y condiciones de la oferta precalificada (producto, monto/línea, vigencia, condiciones clave) en los sistemas y herramientas autorizados, evitando promesas fuera de lo autorizado.

Comunicar de manera clara, precisa y transparente las características, beneficios, restricciones, requisitos, tasas, comisiones, CAT cuando aplique, costos, condiciones y vigencia de la oferta, asegurando la comprensión del cliente.

Cumplir con objetivos individuales de ventas, conversión, productividad y calidad, tales como contactos efectivos, tasa de cierre, cumplimiento de script, calidad de captura y auditorías de llamada.

Contribuir a un ambiente de control interno sólido, identificando y reportando oportunamente incidentes, desviaciones, posibles fraudes, malas prácticas, riesgos operativos o quejas del cliente.
Brindar una experiencia positiva durante todo el contacto: trato respetuoso, lenguaje claro, ritmo adecuado, empatía, y cierre cordial independientemente del resultado.
Participar en calibraciones, coaching y capacitación continua, aplicando retroalimentación para mejorar argumentación, calidad de llamada y resultados.

Resiliencia ante el rechazo.

About the job

Location Cuautitlan, Mexico

FORVIA HELLA is a listed international automotive supplier. As a company of the FORVIA Group, FORVIA HELLA stands for high-performance lighting technology and vehicle electronics and, with the Lifecycle Solutions Business Group, also covers a broad service and product portfolio for the spare parts and workshop business as well as for manufacturers of special vehicles. title: Asistente Operativo y de Marketing - Zona Esmeralda
description:
About the job

¿Eres recién graduado/a, tienes CERO EGO y quieres aprender a construir empresas desde la raíz? 🥑🔥




NOTA IMPORTANTE SOBRE LA VACANTE: Esta posición reporta directamente al Fundador y Director General de ambas marcas. El reclutamiento se realiza a través de Huerta Consulting (nuestra firma de consultoría), pero el rol operará en un 80% para la expansión y consolidación de Macha Gourmet (nuestra marca boutique de alimentos en fase de lanzamiento acelerado) y un 20% en el soporte administrativo de la consultora. ¡Buscamos al talento que nos ayude a poner a Macha Gourmet en el mapa digital y operativo!




Buscamos a nuestro/a próximo/a Operations & Marketing Assistant (Asistente Todoterreno - "Mi Sombra").




Este NO es un rol tradicional de oficina o escritorio. Buscamos a una persona con "chispa", proactiva y que no tenga miedo de ensuciarse las manos. Tu objetivo principal será absorber la operación del día a día para liberar tiempo del Director General.




¿A qué nos referimos con "ensuciarse las manos"? 🛠️

Aquí no hay espacio para el orgullo. Tan pronto puedes estar optimizando campañas avanzadas en Meta, configurando integraciones en ManyChat o buscando proveedores... como al día siguiente te tocará cargar cajas, limpiar chiles en la cocina, cobrar en el punto de venta o atender el stand en un bazar de fin de semana. Hacemos lo que sea necesario para que el negocio ruede.




¿Qué harás en tus dos mundos? (80% Macha Gourmet / 20% Huerta Consulting y Administración)

• Operación y Campo: Coordinar compras en la zona, supervisar producción, cargar insumos y apoyar/supervisar el stand comercial y bazares.

• Marketing y Contenido: Crear campañas digitales, administrar la comunidad y ¡perderle el miedo a la cámara para salir en los videos de nuestras redes sociales!

• Tecnología y Procesos: Dominar el uso funcional de Odoo (facturas, gastos, inventarios) e implementar automatizaciones avanzadas.

• Soporte Administrativo: Ser el brazo derecho del director en el seguimiento de pendientes de la consultora y tareas administrativas generales.




¿Qué necesitas para postularte?

• Ubicación: Vivir indispensablemente en Zona Esmeralda (EdoMex) o zonas muy cercanas.

• Saber manejar: Licencia vigente (indispensable, usarás el auto de la empresa para vueltas operativas).

• Formación: Recién egresado/a de Marketing, Administración, Negocios, Gastronomía o afín (Universidades locales/técnicas bienvenidas).

• Disponibilidad de horario: Rol enfocado en resultados. Habrá jornadas largas y fines de semana demandantes (se compensa con días libres o medios días entre semana).

• Actitud: Proactividad extrema, excelente vibra, gusto por la comida y visión de crecimiento a largo plazo.




¿Qué ofrecemos?

• Sueldo inicial de $12,000 a $15,000 MXN netos mensuales (con ruta clara para escalar hasta $20,000 MXN con base en tus resultados y proactividad de negocio).

• Esquema híbrido (días de home office, días en campo/cocina/stand).

• La mejor escuela de negocios: Mentoría directa del fundador (Managing Partner y Consultor Líder activo) y aprendizaje real de herramientas muy cotizadas (Odoo, ManyChat, Meta Ads).

• Plan de carrera para tomar la dirección operativa completa de Macha Gourmet conforme el negocio crezca.

description:
About the job

We are PMG

Named Ad Age Best Places to Work for 11 years in a row and Fast Company Best Workplaces for Innovators since 2022, PMG is a global independent marketing services and technology company that seeks to inspire people and brands that anything is possible. Driven by shared success, PMG leverages business strategy and transformation, creative, media, and insights—as well as its proprietary operating system, Alli—to deliver cutting-edge digital solutions and innovative media strategies.

Our team comprises over 900 employees globally, and our work for ambitious brands like Apple, Nike, Sephora, Experian, Therabody, Best Western Hotels & Resorts, Creed Fragrances, BNY, Intuit, CKE Restaurants, Travelex, and Whole Foods spans 85+ countries.

Professional proficiency in written and spoken English is required, including for resume submission and interviews.

Who You Will Be Working With

Join a team of innovative thinkers and collaborative problem-solvers who are passionate about the ever-evolving world of paid social media. Our Social team is dynamic, supportive, and dedicated to helping our clients achieve extraordinary results. You’ll work closely with strategists, creatives, data analysts, and technologists to craft campaigns that make a tangible impact on some of the most exciting brands in the industry.

We believe in fostering a culture where every team member feels valued, empowered, and inspired to bring their unique talents to the table. At PMG, your voice will be heard, your ideas embraced, and your growth supported every step of the way. If you’re looking for a role that blends cutting-edge innovation with meaningful collaboration, we’d love to welcome you to our team.

What You Will Do


Shape and execute paid social strategies that align with client objectives, overseeing budget allocation, media planning, reporting, and forecasting in partnership with cross-functional teams. 
Manage the setup and trafficking of campaigns across platforms like Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Snap, and LinkedIn, ensuring best practices and precision in execution. 
Develop and implement testing frameworks to uncover actionable insights, translating complex data into clear, impactful recommendations for clients and internal stakeholders. 
Collaborate with PMG teams and platform partners to optimize campaign performance, offering real-time analysis and subject-matter expertise during client interactions. 
Harness PMG’s proprietary technology, Alli, to streamline workflows, analyze performance data, and unlock deeper campaign insights, contributing to its ongoing enhancement. 
Take ownership of project timelines and deliverables, ensuring campaigns meet strategic goals and exceed expectations. 
Bring a proactive mindset and enthusiasm to each day, inspiring your team and making a meaningful impact on the brands you support. 


What You Will Bring


3+ years of experience in paid social strategy or a related field, with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. 
Intermediate expertise in Paid Social and Content Marketing to craft, execute, and optimize impactful campaigns. 
Foundational knowledge of Marketing Metrics and Marketing Planning & Analysis to drive data-informed strategies and recommendations. 
Proficiency in social media platforms such as Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Snap, and LinkedIn to set up, traffic, and manage campaigns. 
Familiarity with tools like Google Analytics, Microsoft Excel, and SQL to analyze data and deliver clear, actionable performance insights. 
Strong organizational and collaboration skills, enabling seamless alignment with internal teams and external stakeholders. 
An analytical mindset, paired with a proactive approach to uncovering insights, testing strategies, and driving continuous improvements. 
A commitment to curiosity and adaptability as a Continual Learner, staying at the forefront of media innovation while prioritizing client success with a Customer-Focused mindset that seeks opportunities to deliver meaningful value. 
A dedication to People-Focused leadership, fostering collaboration, innovation, and professional growth by Leading by Example and nurturing strong relationships that empower others to excel. 


What We Offer


Professional Development: Take advantage of our learning and development programs, mentorship opportunities, and career advancement support. 
Generous Time Off: Enjoy generous paid time off and holiday allowances to recharge and spend time with loved ones. 
Parental Leave: We provide paid parental leave to support your family during important life events. 
Retirement & Pension Plans: Plan for your future with competitive retirement or pension programs, including contribution matching. 
Fertility and Family Support: Access fertility benefits for all team members and their spouses. 
Healthcare: Coverage and support for everyday medical expenses and routine care, tailored by geography. 
Pet Insurance: Protect your pet's health and your finances. 
Lifestyle Spending Accounts: Enjoy 100% company-funded accounts to promote healthy habits and well-being. 
Commuter Benefits: Access support for travel and commuting needs, where available. 
Annual Bonus: All employees are eligible for an annual bonus. 
Volunteering Opportunities: Receive 8 give-back hours to volunteer in your local communities. 
AI Enterprise License: Access AI Enterprise accounts and participate in weekly AI training sessions to empower and ensure AI safety. 


Benefits vary by country, location, and geography to reflect local laws, norms, and expectations.

What Sets Us Apart

Being part of PMG means joining a company culture that’s unmatched in digital. We're dedicated to working hard to serve our employees and clients, delivering value, results, and innovation—which often requires true grit and agility. We believe in taking care of ourselves and each other to continuously improve in every way.

In alignment with our core values to be inclusive and always change for the better, PMG is committed to creating a more diverse and inclusive culture, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe that we only change for the better by bringing diverse perspectives to our company. PMG recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

We are looking for a detail-oriented, analytically sharp brand analyst to be the operational backbone of the Brand Strategy team. You will manage the BHT, support brief coordination, conduct competitive and cultural research, and produce the analytical inputs that allow the Brand Strategy Lead and Brand Strategy Sr Manager to stay focused on strategy.

In this role, you'll be...


STRATEGY & EXECUTION 
Coordinate and operate BHT waves: collect data from the Insights team, update dashboards, flag brand attribute movements, and maintain version control
Prepare regular competitive benchmarking reports — track how leading digital financial brands communicate across paid, owned, and earned channels
Prepare post-campaign performance summaries tied to brand OKRs — compile data from analytics tools and agency reports
Research cultural trends, category moments, and audience insights to feed into brand strategy planning sessions
Support preparation of strategy presentations and decks for brand reviews, stakeholder meetings, and agency briefings
Maintain brand documentation: tone-of-voice guides, messaging frameworks, and service-specific territory files across DiDi financial services
Cross-train fully on Brand Strategy Sr Manager responsibilities 



 CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION 


Support the Brand Strategy Manager and Brand Strategist Sr in documenting and tracking business team inputs — compile OKRs, priorities, and campaign requests from business teams so the brand team can act on them with speed and accuracy
Coordinate logistics with the external Insights team: send research requests, follow up on deliverables, organize study outputs, and prepare summaries for the team
Support brief documentation: format briefs, manage version control, and maintain the active brief file library
Assist in preparing materials that the Brand Strategist Sr takes to creative agency meetings



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


3–5 years of experience in brand management, marketing strategy, or a planning role at an agency or in-house team
Experience operating brand tracking tools or coordinating research projects is highly valued
Strong analytical mindset — comfortable working with data from multiple sources and synthesizing it into clear summaries
Excellent attention to detail and documentation skills
Proficiency in PowerPoint or Google Slides and Excel or Google Sheets for analysis and presentation building
Proactive and self-directed — able to manage recurring tasks independently without constant guidance
Fluent in English and Spanish



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

About the job

Objetivo de la posición: 

El analista de merchandise ayudan al Gerente de Categoría a maximizar la rentabilidad de sus líneas de productos asignadas. Esto implica la selección de productos, revisiones de líneas, publicidad, marketing, niveles de inventario, análisis de garantías y negociaciones importantes con proveedores. Otras funciones dentro de este rol incluyen trabajar estrechamente con los Gerentes de Categoría para determinar y ejecutar estrategias y tácticas a nivel de categoría para impulsar el crecimiento rentable. Esta persona también utilizará información obtenida de muchos informes para identificar oportunidades para mejorar las ventas, el porcentaje de margen bruto y el retorno sobre la inversión en inventario (GMROI). Una vez que se demuestre la competencia en estos roles, el Analista de Merchandise será asignado a líneas para gestionarlas de manera independiente.




Actividades principales: 

Realizar análisis de líneas de productos (tendencias de ventas por unidad hacia arriba/abajo, tendencia de ventas en pesos hacia arriba/abajo, tendencia de ventas en pesos de la utilidad hacia arriba/abajo, tendencia de porcentaje de la utilidad hacia arriba/abajo, adición/eliminación de SKU) y presentar recomendaciones al Gerente de Producto y al director.
Ayudar a los Gerentes de Categoría con la planificación y ejecución de promociones.
Comunicarse con las tiendas y/o otros departamentos según sea necesario para garantizar la ejecución impecable de proyectos de comercialización (cambios de precios, cambios de programas, actualizaciones de VFR, revisiones de guiones de capacitación, reuniones de planificación, alertas de productos, etc).
Trabajar estrechamente con todos los departamentos que afectan el flujo de mercancías (es decir, Compras, Contabilidad, Operaciones de Tiendas, Operaciones de DC, Ventas, Marketing/Publicidad, Control de Inventario y Precios).
Hacer recomendaciones para planes estratégicos de negocios utilizando información extensa, desde informes internos hasta negociaciones y discusiones con proveedores y publicaciones de la industria.
Determina la mejor manera de analizar, estructurar y entregar análisis claros y perspicaces para abordar preguntas operativas.
Supervisa la construcción de planes de negocios basados en la revisión analítica de datos históricos, datos competitivos y análisis FODA.
Capacidad para presentar información compleja de manera comprensible y convincente al equipo de replenishment y a las partes interesadas clave.
Ejecute informes semanales, mensuales y trimestrales.




Requisitos del puesto: 

1 - 2 años de experiencia en posiciones similares
Licenciatura terminada
Inglés básico - intermedio (con interés en desarrollarlo y desenvolverse a mediado plazo)

Conocimiento en costos, margen bruto y cálculos de descuentos, así como, en elaboración de Informes

skills: Support client updates and weekly reporting with accurate, on‑time inputs; explain results and next steps in plain language tied to goals.
Execute approved changes (e.g., promo, budget, pacing) within guardrails; escalate when trade‑offs are needed.
Own day-to-day campaign execution across Paid Social (Meta, TikTok, etc)
Apply solid Paid Social craft (creative + audience + signal quality) and grow your awareness of how Social connects to Search, Commerce, TVAD, and Creative.

Apply the Tinuiti Way playbooks and best practices: follow the standard SOPs, checklists, and templates for Paid Social setup, QA, delivery checks, and weekly readouts; meet our quality bars (pixel/CAPI health and event mapping, UTMs, catalog/DPA integrity, creative rotation/fatigue, audience overlap, and policy/brand‑safety compliance).
Escalate deviations promptly, capture outcomes in the standard readout format, and share feedback through existing channels.

About the job

Tinuiti is the largest independent full-funnel marketing agency in the U.S. across the media that matters most, with $4 billion in digital media under management and more than 1,200 employees. Built for marketers who demand growth and accountability, Tinuiti unites media and measurement under one roof to eliminate waste—the biggest growth killer of all—and scale what works. Its proprietary technology, Bliss Point by Tinuiti, reveals the truth around growth and waste, and how to capitalize on it. With expert teams across Commerce, Search, Social, TV & Audio, and more, Tinuiti delivers measurable results with brutal simplicity: Love Growth. Hate Waste.

We’d Love To Hear From You If

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you qualify, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

description:
About the job

About the Company:

Wayfinder Agency is the #1 digital marketing agency for tabletop game companies, a fully remote team of marketers, media buyers, and creatives who help incredible games reach players around the world. Our campaigns have generated millions in Kickstarter pledges and eCommerce revenue for brands like Ravensburger, Roll20, Paizo, and Pandasaurus. We’re not your typical agency: we move fast, think creatively, and care deeply about performance. We operate with a lean, collaborative culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership, and if you love strategy, data, and working with passionate creative teams, you’ll fit right in. 




About the Role:

We’re hiring a hands-on Senior Designer & Team Lead who will personally produce high-performing static and motion ads for paid digital campaigns every week, while also mentoring and developing a small remote creative team of 3-4 designers. This role is both a working creative seat and a leadership seat: you’ll build the templates, best practices, and workflows the team runs on, stay close to real performance data, and help define how creative gets made at a growing agency. A genuine passion for tabletop games and gaming culture is a major plus.




This role is a Full-Time remote position.




We are looking for a Senior Designer & Team Lead specifically with these requirements:

Demonstrated ability to personally produce high-performing static and simple motion ads for paid digital campaigns, with speed and consistency.
Strong portfolio of direct-response ad creative, ideally showing work built from client-provided assets (performance ads matter more than brand campaigns).
Experience developing creative that drives performance metrics such as CTR, ROAS, conversions, and customer acquisition.
Experience mentoring or managing designers in a remote setting, giving effective creative feedback, and improving team processes.
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and related design tools, with an efficient, template-smart workflow.
Highly self-directed, with strong communication and organizational skills and the confidence to own your workload in a fully remote environment.
Strong English speaking and writing skills.




Nice to Haves:

A genuine personal interest in tabletop gaming. 
Familiarity with gaming culture more broadly, including Kickstarter launches, conventions, and the communities around them.
Experience designing for niche or enthusiast audiences.
Creative writing abilities to take general concepts and add compelling copy




Your responsibility will include (but not limited to):

Personally design and produce static and simple motion ad-creative for paid social and digital platforms, working from account manager briefs and client-provided assets (our account managers own both the brief and the ad copy, so you can focus entirely on visual craft and execution).
Deliver work reliably on quick timelines that support ongoing creative testing and iteration.
Develop and document creative best practices, design standards, templates, and workflows that make the whole team faster and more consistent.
Lead, mentor, and develop a small remote creative team of 3-4 designers: assign work, balance bandwidth, give constructive design feedback, and support each designer’s professional growth.
Review team deliverables for quality, brand alignment, and performance potential.
Collaborate closely with account management, media buying, and leadership to keep creative aligned with campaign goals and performance objectives.
Communicate proactively with leadership regarding project status, resourcing needs, risks, and opportunities.
Stay current on paid social creative best practices, platform requirements, and trends within gaming and tabletop communities.




Growth Opportunities/Perks:

Opportunity to grow and develop the creative team as the agency scales.
Fully remote work environment.
A chance to define how creative gets made at a growing agency.
Direct exposure to a fast-moving, performance-driven creative team.




You’re a Great Fit for This Role If…

 ✅ You know what high-performing paid social creative looks like and can produce it yourself.

 ✅ You care about measurable outcomes such as CTR, conversions, and ROAS-not just visual quality.

 ✅ You work quickly, stay organized, and can turn limited client-provided assets into effective ads.

 ✅ You enjoy mentoring designers, giving clear feedback, and helping a creative team improve.

 ✅ You communicate proactively and thrive in a fast-moving, remote agency environment.




Our hiring process is made up of four parts, so please be aware that you will need to dedicate time for a questionnaire, a video, and two 1-on-1 interviews.




Thank you for taking the time to consider this position. We look forward to hearing from you soon!

title: Ejecutivo de Prospección y Ventas
description:
About the job




Prospección digital, generación de leads y desarrollo comercial para proyectos hoteleros y desarrollos inmobiliarios.

En ACERDOORS suministramos e instalamos puertas técnicas y contrafuego para proyectos hoteleros, desarrollos inmobiliarios y edificios corporativos.

Buscamos un(a) Ejecutivo de Prospección y Ventas cazador(a), responsable de generar oportunidades comerciales: identificar clientes potenciales, contactarlos, agendar reuniones y alimentar el pipeline de ventas.

Es un puesto 100% comercial. Trabaja de la mano con el Gerente Comercial y se apoya en el contenido que produce el área de Contenido y Redes, pero su foco es prospectar y abrir oportunidades, no crear contenido.

Objetivo del puesto

Generar de manera constante leads calificados y reuniones comerciales mediante prospección digital (Social Selling) y seguimiento disciplinado en el CRM, para alimentar el pipeline de ventas de ACERDOORS.

Principales responsabilidades

Prospección

• Identificar empresas, desarrolladores, despachos de arquitectura y tomadores de decisión.

• Contactar prospectos por LinkedIn, WhatsApp, correo y llamada usando estrategias de Social Selling.

• Dar seguimiento a las conversaciones hasta agendar reuniones comerciales.

• Generar leads calificados para el Gerente Comercial.

Administración del pipeline (CRM)

• Registrar y administrar el pipeline de prospección en el CRM.

• Mantener actualizada la base de datos de clientes potenciales.

• Programar y ejecutar seguimientos de forma disciplinada.

• Elaborar reportes semanales de actividad y resultados (leads, citas y avance).

Desarrollo comercial

• Acompañar al Gerente Comercial en reuniones cuando se requiera.

• Colaborar con el área de Contenido para contar con material y mensajes de prospección efectivos.

• Alcanzar y superar las metas mensuales de prospección.

Perfil

Persona proactiva, persistente y orientada a resultados, cómoda buscando y contactando clientes todos los días, motivada por un esquema de comisiones.

Formación

Mercadotecnia, Comunicación, Administración, Negocios o afín. (Título no indispensable si existe experiencia comprobable.)

Experiencia

• 1 a 3 años en prospección, ventas B2B, desarrollo de negocios o Social Selling.

• Experiencia contactando prospectos y agendando citas por canales digitales.

• Deseable experiencia en construcción, arquitectura, industria o inmobiliario.

Conocimientos indispensables

Prospección comercial

Contacto y seguimiento de prospectos por LinkedIn, WhatsApp y correo, y agendado de citas.

CRM

Experiencia administrando el pipeline en HubSpot, Zoho, Pipedrive, Salesforce o similar.

Conocimientos deseables

LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads y manejo de indicadores y metas.

Habilidades

• Excelente comunicación.

• Facilidad para relacionarse.

• Persistencia comercial.

• Organización y disciplina de seguimiento.

• Orientación a resultados.

Inglés

Deseable nivel de lectura y conversación entre 40% y 70%.

Ofrecemos

• Sueldo base de $10,000 a $12,000 MXN según experiencia.

• Esquema de comisiones sin tope, siendo el principal componente del ingreso (ver Esquema de comisiones).

• Periodo de prueba de 3 (tres) meses; durante este periodo el pago se realiza fuera de nómina.

• Capacitación continua, herramientas de trabajo y acceso a CRM.

• Prestaciones de ley y contratación permanente.

Esquema de comisiones

Adicionalmente al salario base, se reconocerá una comisión sobre el precio de venta de los proyectos, excluyendo instalación y fletes, conforme a los siguientes parámetros:

• 2% (dos por ciento) sobre el precio de venta neto (sin instalación ni fletes) de todos los proyectos que el colaborador prospecte, genere y traiga directamente a la empresa.

• 1% (uno por ciento) sobre el precio de venta neto (sin instalación ni fletes) en proyectos asignados por la empresa al colaborador.

• Comisiones sin tope: a mayor prospección efectiva, mayor ingreso.

Modalidad

• Presencial. Lunes a viernes de 9:00 a 18:00 hrs.

• Con disponibilidad ocasional para reuniones y visitas comerciales.

description:
About the job

About Sezzle: 

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role: 

We are seeking a talented and motivated Merchant Risk Analyst who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Sezzle currently partners with over 20,000 active merchants to offer their customers the ability to split orders into 4 interest-free payments over 6 weeks. As a Merchant Risk Analyst, you will be responsible for ensuring that none of our merchant partners are exhibiting behaviors that could negatively impact Sezzle or our customers. This means constantly monitoring all of our current merchant partners, as well as declining unsuitable merchants at the time of application. Essentially, it is your job to set and maintain a certain level of excellence for the merchants that Sezzle chooses to partner itself with and offer its services to. Analysts will also make recommendations to our management on how to improve and scale our processes.

We are looking for a teammate who can work full-time Tuesday through Saturday between 9:00 am - 5:30 pm - Central Time. This will be a salaried, contractor position. 

What You'll Do: 


Actively analyze merchant applications by evaluating risk scores, products, and policies 
Investigate high-risk merchant account activity to minimize loss from fraud and reputational risks 
Communicate and coordinate processes between teams to refine the merchant approval process
Write and execute queries in MySQL to analyze merchant information and performance metrics 
Analyze merchant reputational risk based on customer NPS reviews
Work as a mediator between the Merchant Success and Support teams to resolve merchant risk-related issues and provide guidance on overall risk tolerance and policy 
Improve current merchant fraud detection framework to find fraud more effectively 
Perform extensive analysis on ways the merchant approval process can be streamlined and automated and challenge the status quo by working collaboratively, as well as independently, on projects focused on improving methods, policies, and internal tools. 


What We Look For: 


Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution 
Minimum 1 year of experience in risk management, fraud or financial crime prevention operations 
Experienced in analyzing data and comfortable making impactful decisions in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment
Work experience with MYSQL, PostgreSQL 
Attention to detail and ability to multitask 
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills 
Strong business judgment and communication skills 
Ability to self-start and work with minimal supervision after training 
Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.


Preferred Qualifications


2+ years of experience in real-world analytical experience in merchant/business fraud and credit risk management, fraud or financial crime prevention operations in e-commerce, banking, fintech or financial institutions is a plus 
Ideal candidate will be available to start within two weeks following an offer


About You: 


You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed. 
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking. 
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully. 
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly. 
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle. 


What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome: 

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Compensation: The compensation range for the role is $1,800 - $2,000 USD GROSS monthly as a contractor. Our ranges are very broad to accommodate all types of candidates and encourage growth. Specific compensation offered to a candidate may be dependent on factors such as education, experience, qualifications, and alignment with market data. Exceptional candidates may receive salaries outside of the posted ranges.
